description: Retrieve TLS certificate details for a domain — issuer, validity period, subject alternative names (SANs), chain trust status. Optionally returns the full chain. Use this when investigating SAN-based pivots (other domains on the same cert), expired/self-signed cert posture, or CT-log evidence of recent issuance. Do NOT use this to enumerate subdomains directly (use `subdomain_lookup`); SANs are a side effect, not the primary signal.

domain.description: The domain name to check TLS certificate for (e.g., example.com)

include_chain.description: Whether to include the full certificate chain in the response; defaults to false

use_fresh_data.description: Whether to get fresh data instead of cached results; defaults to false

name: ssl_certificates
